content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, Thank you for sending over the contract. Before I sign, I would like to propose a few small adjustments to the agreement:

- Regarding the clause allowing for potential extensions, the agreement currently does not define how extra work is handled; I propose that any extension of services beyond the initial three products shall be agreed upon in a written change order detailing the additional work and applicable fees.
- Regarding the termination clause, only one party can terminate without cause; I propose that either party may terminate this agreement without cause by giving sixty (60) days written notice to the other party.
- Regarding the indemnification clause, the liability is currently uncapped; I propose that the Contractor's total liability under this Agreement shall be capped at the total fees paid by the Client under this Agreement, excluding indemnification obligations for third-party intellectual property infringement.

Looking forward to hearing from you. Best regards,
